items.title: Ludo.ai launches AI Tileset Generator for 2D games
items.excerpt: Ludo.ai's Tileset Generator builds 16-tile terrain and line sets for 2D games from a ground description, with top-down and isometric grids, browser testing and engine exports.
items.rationale: A new tool that 2D artists can use tomorrow: it generates engine-ready 16-tile terrain sets in top-down or isometric grids. It is a different product from Ludo's 11-13 open-source agent toolbox.

items.title: Instead of just describing where things go, you can annotate (draw, select, point) in the scene - Unity Spark Annotate
items.excerpt: Unity shows Annotate in Unity Spark: draw, select or point directly on the game scene to give the AI exact visual context instead of describing placement in text; closed-beta waitlist open.
items.rationale: A new Unity Spark feature that lets you draw or point in the scene to direct the AI instead of describing placement in text. It is a real interaction change for level and scene designers, and it comes from the primary source.

items.title: Another Modder Uses AI to Make a Multiplayer Mode for The Last of Us Part 2, Insists There Isn't Much Sony Can Do About It 'Even if They Do Shut Me Down'
items.excerpt: A modder says they used AI tools to build a multiplayer mode for The Last of Us Part 2 and argues Sony can do little to stop AI-assisted mods even with takedowns.
items.rationale: AI tools let a single modder build a multiplayer mode for a major first-party game, and the modder argues takedowns cannot stop it. It is a concrete new case of AI-assisted modding pushing on IP control.

items.title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby AI clone laden with ads taken off mobile platforms after fans report it en masse to Cygames
items.excerpt: An ad-stuffed AI-generated knockoff of Umamusume: Pretty Derby, 'Anime Racing Academy', was struck off mobile storefronts after fans mass-reported it to Cygames.
items.rationale: An actual takedown: an AI-generated knockoff was removed from mobile stores after fans reported it to Cygames. It is a new event in the AI-clone fight, after the 11-14 and 11-24 advice pieces.

items.title: 『Slay the Spire 2』の超難関アセンション10を「80％クリアできるAI」が誕生。142億回の決断と“先読み”で、猛者の領域に
items.excerpt: A research paper proposes AlphaDefect, a reinforcement-learning system trained on 14.2 billion decisions that clears Slay the Spire 2's hardest Ascension 10 about 80% of the time.
items.rationale: A new research result: an RL agent trained on 14.2 billion decisions clears Slay the Spire 2 on Ascension 10 about 80% of the time. That is relevant to balance testing and AI playtesting for deckbuilders.
